2656: closed spec fn wf(self) -> bool {
2657:     invariant on lock with (val, guard, ghost_id) is (v: usize, g: RwPerms<T>) {
2658:         let has_writer_bit: bool = (v & WRITER) != 0;
2659:         let has_upgrade_bit: bool = (v & UPGRADEABLE_READER) != 0;
2660:         let has_max_reader_bit: bool = (v & MAX_READER) != 0;
2661:         let total_reader_bits: int = (v & MAX_READER_MASK) as int;
2662:         let reader_bits: int = if has_max_reader_bit { MAX_READER as int } else { (v & READER_MASK) as int };
2663: 
2664: 
2665:         let active_writer: bool = g.core_token.is_right();
2666:         let active_upgrade_guard: bool = !active_writer && g.upreader_guard_token is None;
2667:         let active_read_guards: int = if g.read_guard_token is Left {
2668:             MAX_READER_U64 - g.read_guard_token.left().frac()
2669:         } else {
2670:             0
2671:         };
2672:         let pending_failed_upread_attempt: bool = g.upread_retract_token is None;
2673:         let failed_reader_attempts: int = V_MAX_READ_RETRACT_FRACS - g.read_retract_token.frac();
2674: 
2675:         &&& if g.core_token.is_left() {
2676:             g.read_guard_token is Left
2677:         } else {
2678:             &&& g.upreader_guard_token is None
2679:             &&& g.read_guard_token is Right
2680:         }
2681:         &&& has_upgrade_bit <==> (active_upgrade_guard || pending_failed_upread_attempt)
2682:         &&& !(active_upgrade_guard && pending_failed_upread_attempt)
2683:         &&& total_reader_bits == active_read_guards + failed_reader_attempts
2684:         &&& active_writer <==> has_writer_bit
2685:         &&& 0 <= active_read_guards <= reader_bits <= total_reader_bits
2686:         &&& !(active_writer && (active_read_guards + if active_upgrade_guard { 1int } else { 0 }) > 0)
2687:         &&& g.core_token.id() == ghost_id@.core_token_id
2688:         &&& g.core_token.wf()
2689:         &&& g.core_token.is_left() ==> {
2690:             &&& !g.core_token.is_resource_owner()
2691:             &&& g.core_token.frac() == 1
2692:         }
2693:         &&& g.core_token.is_right() ==> {
2694:             let empty = g.core_token.resource_right();
2695:             &&& empty.id() == ghost_id@.frac_id
2696:             &&& g.core_token.frac() == 2
2697:             &&& g.core_token.has_resource()
2698:         }
2699:         &&& g.read_retract_token.wf()
2700:         &&& g.read_retract_token.id() == ghost_id@.read_retract_token_id
2701:         &&& g.upread_retract_token is Some ==>
2702:             {
2703:                 let token = g.upread_retract_token->0;
2704:                 &&& token.wf()
2705:                 &&& token.id() == ghost_id@.upread_retract_token_id
2706:             }
2707:         &&& g.upreader_guard_token is Some ==> {
2708:             let token = g.upreader_guard_token->0;
2709:             wf_upgradeable_guard_token(ghost_id@.core_token_id, ghost_id@.frac_id, val.id(), token)
2710:         }
2711:         &&& match g.read_guard_token {
2712:             Sum::Left(token) => {
2713:                 &&& token.wf()
2714:                 &&& token.id() == ghost_id@.read_guard_token_id
2715:                 &&& token.not_empty() ==> {
2716:                     let resource = token.resource();
2717:                     let read_half_cell_perm = resource.0;
2718:                     let mode_knowledge = resource.1;
2719:                     &&& mode_knowledge.id() == ghost_id@.core_token_id
2720:                     &&& read_half_cell_perm.id() == ghost_id@.frac_id
2721:                     &&& read_half_cell_perm.resource().id() == val.id()
2722:                     &&& read_half_cell_perm.frac() == 1
2723:                 }
2724:             },
2725:             Sum::Right(empty) => {
2726:                 &&& empty.id() == ghost_id@.read_guard_token_id
2727:             },
2728:         }
2729: 
2730:     }
2731: }
